day.text: A rail-stone of the Rune Bridge, cut all over with runes. By day they're only grooves; whatever they say, they say it in the dark.

read.text:
The runes burn blue in the dark, and the grooves become words, in the Passengers' old letters:

"On the hundredth night, by the old standing stone, / the last light was little, and frightened, and alone."
